He took over management after his father’s death, having worked in project management and sales. Alongside its performance cars and tuning components, he has developed the group’s activities in business vans and boats.

long_biography.plain_text:
Digital systems became central to Constantin Buschmann’s management of BRABUS. He extended their use from project reporting to vehicle acceptance and staff leave requests, making internal work more consistently organised around defined processes. His earlier management roles helped him secure the support of established partners, suppliers and banks as he changed the business.

He also made himself a public face of the company. Rather than outsource its social media output, BRABUS built an internal production team. Buschmann required a regular publishing schedule, treating the work like a media operation. Product presentations and glimpses behind the scenes gave audiences a way to encounter the business beyond a showroom or motor show.
